column1: # unseeded_form_globals.tsv -- globals a non-form caller reads that only the
# dialog sets. Ordered by RULING_SETTLEMENT_QUESTIONS_2026-09-03 as the census
# step; the failing check and its exemptions follow.
# THE TEST. A name assigned ONLY in graphs/eml-graphs-form.praat and read
# somewhere outside it. Praat's `include` is a parse-time paste, so a global
# assigned in one file and read in another is ordinary and fine -- the defect
# is narrower: the only assignment lives behind the dialog, so a caller that
# never opened the dialog reads a variable that does not exist and Praat aborts
# the whole figure at "Unknown variable: <name>". That is what
# @emlInitializeDrawingDefaults exists to prevent, and the seeded column says
# CALIBRATED, because a census nobody tested is a list. Run against the tree at
# 84449958^ -- the commit before scatterCorrScope was seeded -- this test finds
# scatterCorrScope, unseeded, with 5 reads outside the form, and does NOT find
# scatterAnalysisType, which was already seeded there. One known positive
# caught, one known negative not raised.
# NOT ADJUDICATED. Every row is a candidate. Several are read in
# stats/eml-record.praat, which is the recorder -- the same path on which
# scatterCorrScope was making recorded scatter figures record nothing at all.
